audience.text: Developers building .NET applications targeting netcoreapp3.1, net6.0, net8.0, or net10.0 who need to programmatically create, manipulate, and convert 3D scenes.

capabilities.text: Construct and manage 3D scene graphs using Scene and Node, with support for child node attachment and entity assignment.
capabilities.title: Scene graph construction

capabilities.text: Create primitive shapes (Box, Cylinder, Sphere, etc.) and IFC-compatible 2D profiles (LShape, TShape, etc.) for solid modeling.
capabilities.title: Primitive and profile geometry

capabilities.text: Assign shading materials including LambertMaterial, PhongMaterial, PbrMaterial, and ShaderMaterial to nodes.
capabilities.title: Material assignment

capabilities.text: Animate scenes using AnimationClip, AnimationChannel, KeyFrame, Bone, Skeleton, SkinDeformer, and MorphTargetDeformer.
capabilities.title: Animation support

capabilities.text: Convert scenes between FBX, glTF, OBJ, STL, COLLADA, 3MF, 3DS, PLY, AMF, and HTML5 viewer export formats.
capabilities.title: Format conversion

capabilities.text: Read and write per-vertex mesh data including normals, UVs, vertex color, tangent/binormal, smoothing groups, and user data.
capabilities.title: Mesh vertex data handling

capabilities.text: Define NURBS curves and surfaces using control points, weights, and knot vectors via NurbsCurve and NurbsSurface.
capabilities.title: NURBS data definition

limitations.text: Rendering is not implemented — Scene.Render and related APIs throw NotImplementedException.
PLY import/export works via Scene.Open/Save but direct use of PLYFormat.Encode/Decode throws NotImplementedException.
PolygonModifier and most TriMesh helpers throw NotImplementedException — mesh post-processing utilities are not functional.
NURBS evaluation and surface-to-mesh conversion throw NotImplementedException.
3MF build metadata and RVM attribute loading are not implemented despite core geometry support.
License and Metered APIs exist for API compatibility but are not applicable to this open-source edition.

problems_solved.text: Enables programmatic construction of 3D scene graphs using primitives and IFC-style profiles, with support for assigning materials and animating hierarchies.
Supports round-trip conversion between widely used 3D interchange formats including FBX, glTF, OBJ, STL, COLLADA, 3MF, and RVM.
Provides pure managed-code 3D processing with no native dependencies, simplifying deployment across Windows, Linux, and macOS.

product_summary.text: Aspose.3D FOSS for .NET is a free, open-source MIT-licensed .NET library for building, traversing, and converting 3D scenes without external 3D engines.
